outcomes.subject: Biology
outcomes.title: Cell organelles
outcomes.remember: Mitochondria produce most aerobic ATP; ribosomes build proteins; the nucleus contains DNA.

outcomes.subject: Biology
outcomes.title: Mendelian inheritance
outcomes.remember: An Aa × Aa cross has genotype ratio 1 AA : 2 Aa : 1 aa. A recessive phenotype requires aa.

outcomes.subject: Biology
outcomes.title: Enzymes and reactions
outcomes.remember: Enzymes lower activation energy. They do not change the equilibrium or become consumed.

outcomes.subject: Chemistry
outcomes.title: Moles and molar mass
outcomes.remember: Amount in moles = mass in grams / molar mass in grams per mole.

outcomes.subject: Chemistry
outcomes.title: pH of strong acids
outcomes.remember: For a dilute strong monoprotic acid, pH = −log₁₀[H⁺].

outcomes.subject: Chemistry
outcomes.title: Chemical bonds
outcomes.remember: Ionic bonding involves electron transfer; covalent bonding involves shared electron pairs.

outcomes.subject: Physics
outcomes.title: Constant acceleration
outcomes.remember: For constant acceleration, v = u + at and displacement = ut + ½at².

outcomes.subject: Physics
outcomes.title: Ohm’s law
outcomes.remember: For an ohmic resistor, voltage = current × resistance. Keep units in volts, amperes and ohms.

outcomes.subject: Mathematics
outcomes.title: Linear and quadratic equations
outcomes.remember: Apply the same operation to both sides. Check solutions by substitution.

outcomes.subject: Mathematics
outcomes.title: Probability
outcomes.remember: For equally likely outcomes, probability = favourable outcomes / total outcomes.

outcomes.subject: Mathematics
outcomes.title: Percentage change
outcomes.remember: An increase of r% multiplies a value by 1 + r/100. Consecutive changes multiply.

outcomes.subject: Logic
outcomes.title: Valid deductions
outcomes.remember: A conclusion must follow from the premises. “Some” does not mean “all”.
